metadata.description: Opinionated, project-agnostic guidelines that tell coding agents how to refactor and develop code, one plugin per action, one skill per stack.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Refactoring guidelines for coding agents, one skill per stack. Skills: refactor:dotnet (version-agnostic C#/.NET refactoring), refactor:dotnet8 (behavior-preserving refactoring of layered/DDD .NET 8 backends), refactor:react (React/TypeScript refactoring).

plugins.name: develop
plugins.description: Development guidelines for coding agents writing new code, one skill per stack. Skills: develop:dotnet8 (new features and fixes in layered/DDD .NET 8 backends), develop:react (new React/TypeScript components, hooks, and features).
